description: This file contains core variable tracking classes and systems for Dynamo, including VariableTracker base class, MutationType hierarchy, and related utilities for managing variable states, mutations, and scope within Dynamo's compilation process.

classes.name: SourceType
classes.description: Enum class dividing VariableTracker into Existing or New based on variable origin.

classes.name: MutationType
classes.description: Base class encoding mutation permissions and scope for variables.

classes.name: ValueMutationNew
classes.description: Indicates mutation allowed on a value created during tracing.

classes.name: ValueMutationExisting
classes.description: Indicates mutation allowed on a pre-existing value.

classes.name: AttributeMutationExisting
classes.description: Indicates attribute mutation on a pre-existing object.

classes.name: AttributeMutationNew
classes.description: Indicates attribute mutation on a newly created object.

classes.name: AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError
classes.description: Exception class for unimplemented constant conversion.

classes.name: VariableTrackerMeta
classes.description: Metaclass managing registration and instance checks for VariableTracker subclasses.

classes.name: ImplicitRealizingVariableTrackerMeta
classes.description: Metaclass enabling isinstance checks with LazyVariableTracker.

classes.name: VariableTracker
classes.description: Base class for tracked variables, providing methods for type info, attribute access, mutation, and more.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the VariableTracker with optional modifications.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively walks through VariableTracker instances within a value, applying a callback.

methods.name: python_type
methods.description: Returns the Python type of the variable, or raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: as_python_constant
methods.description: Converts the variable to a Python constant, or raises AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError.

methods.name: guard_as_python_constant
methods.description: Attempts to convert to constant with guards, or raises unimplemented.

methods.name: is_python_constant
methods.description: Checks if the variable can be converted to a Python constant.

methods.name: is_constant_match
methods.description: Checks if the variable matches any of the provided constant values.

methods.name: is_constant_none
methods.description: Checks if the variable is a constant None.

methods.name: make_guard
methods.description: Creates a guard for the variable using a provided function.

methods.name: const_getattr
methods.description: Gets an attribute as a Python constant.

methods.name: is_symnode_like
methods.description: Returns True if the value can participate in SymNode operations.

methods.name: is_tensor
methods.description: Returns True if the variable is a tensor.

methods.name: get_handler_type_for_dispatch
methods.description: Returns the type used for builtin handler dispatch.

methods.name: var_getattr
methods.description: Gets an attribute and returns a new VariableTracker.

methods.name: is_proxy
methods.description: Returns True if the variable can be represented as a proxy.

methods.name: as_proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy representation of the variable.

methods.name: maybe_fx_node
methods.description: Returns the FX node if the proxy is an FX Proxy.

methods.name: reconstruct
methods.description: Reconstructs the variable in codegen.

methods.name: unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Unpacks the variable into a sequence of VariableTrackers.

methods.name: force_unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Eagerly unpacks the variable into a sequence.

methods.name: has_unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Checks if the variable can be unpacked into a sequence.

methods.name: has_force_unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Checks if eager unpacking is supported.

methods.name: force_apply_to_var_sequence
methods.description: Applies a function to each element of the unpacked sequence.

methods.name: call_obj_hasattr
methods.description: Calls hasattr on the object.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Calls a function with VariableTracker arguments.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Calls a method with VariableTracker arguments.

methods.name: call_tree_map
methods.description: Performs a tree map operation over the variable.

methods.name: call_tree_map_branch
methods.description: Performs a branch of tree map operation.

methods.name: _tree_map_fallback
methods.description: Fallback implementation for tree map.

methods.name: set_name_hint
methods.description: Sets a name hint for the variable.

methods.name: realize
methods.description: Builds the real VariableTracker from a LazyVariableTracker.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the underlying VariableTracker if available.

methods.name: is_realized
methods.description: Checks if the variable is realized.

methods.name: next_variable
methods.description: Traces the next() call on the variable.

methods.name: is_strict_mode
methods.description: Checks if strict mode applies.

methods.name: is_mutable
methods.description: Returns True if mutation is allowed.

methods.name: is_immutable
methods.description: Returns True if mutation is disallowed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Factory method to create VariableTracker from value and source.

methods.name: is_python_hashable
methods.description: Checks if the underlying Python object is hashable.

methods.name: get_python_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the underlying Python object.

methods.name: is_python_equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on underlying Python object.
